comment: What Rose's builder may start a new app from (prototypes/voice-phone-demo/rose/app_builder/starters.py). A create request names one template id and one theme id; the generated project vendors `shared`, that template and that theme, and its app module calls RoseTheme(<theme object>) { <template object>.App() }. Keep in step with matrix/src/main/kotlin/app/rose/starters/matrix/Pilots.kt.
